title: S&P 500 Notches Record Close at 7,799 as Cool July CPI Eases Rate-Hike Fears; Brent Crude Drops 2%
summary: July CPI rose 0.1% MoM and 3.4% YoY (both matching forecasts); core CPI slowed to 2.5% annually, the coolest since 2021. S&P 500 closed at 7,798.99 (27th record close of 2026, intraday high 7,816.70); Nasdaq +0.81% to 26,803; Dow +0.13%. Brent crude fell 2% to $87.07/bbl, WTI to $81.25.
why: 延续报道：通胀数据8月12日发布后美股创新高，市场情绪持续至8月14日；直接影响全组合估值，降低Fed 9月加息预期有利于持仓成本和Sell Put隐含波动率环境。

title: Wholesale Prices Flat in July, Below 0.2% Estimate; Annual PPI Cools to 4.7% from 5.5%
summary: U.S. July PPI was unchanged month-over-month (consensus: +0.2%), with annual rate easing to 4.7% from 5.5%. Core PPI +0.2% (vs. +0.3% expected). Data continues the disinflation narrative alongside Wednesday's CPI print, further reducing near-term Fed rate-hike premium.
why: PPI低于预期强化通胀降温叙事，为美联储9月按兵不动提供支撑；有利于全组合风险情绪，Sell Put策略受益于加息尾部风险降低。

title: China Tech Earnings Renew Focus on Hardware Stocks Over Internet as Hang Seng Falls for Fourth Day
summary: Hang Seng fell ~1.1% to 25,137 (4th consecutive decline); Hang Seng Tech Index -1.77%. SMIC climbed 6.4% after earnings beat. Meituan -3%+, JD.com -6%+ after Q2 revenue -2.9%. Bloomberg: China earnings season creating bifurcation — hardware/chips outperform, internet platforms lag on consumer demand recovery.
why: 港股持仓（腾讯、美团）全面承压；半导体（中芯）逆势走强体现资金轮动；美团Sell Put行权价隐含风险上升，建议关注期权Delta管理。

title: Nvidia's $500B AI Plan Envelops Wall Street: Bloomberg Deep Dive on MoUs with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Goldman & KKR
summary: Bloomberg Aug 14 analysis examines Nvidia's plan mobilizing $500B+ via MoUs with six major asset managers (Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, KKR). Goal: ease credit for AI startups buying GPUs. Jensen Huang: AI compute becoming an 'investable asset class.' No firm financial commitments disclosed.
why: 英伟达AI基础设施融资扩大GPU需求生态，间接支撑美光、SK海力士HBM需求长期逻辑；AI主线持续主导美股科技估值，利好组合整体风险偏好。

title: Tencent Q2 2026: Revenue +11% Beats, Profit Misses as AI CapEx Surge Turns Free Cash Flow Negative
summary: Q2 revenue RMB 204.8B (+11% YoY, beat est. 202.2B). Reported net profit RMB 56B (+0.7% YoY, missed est. 61.8B); non-IFRS profit RMB 68.4B (+9%). Domestic gaming +17%, marketing services +22%. CapEx jumped to RMB 52.8B (×1.65 QoQ); free cash flow -RMB 13.8B. Stock fell 4.77% on Aug 13 to HK$441. Management: stock is 'dislocated,' buybacks continue.
why: 延续报道：Q2财报8月12日发布后腾讯股价8月13日大跌4.77%，持仓核心标的面临压力；AI CapEx大幅加速（半年资本支出约等于全年历史水平），近期FCF为负或压制股价；管理层继续回购提供支撑，Covered Call可考虑作为保护策略。

title: SanDisk 2026 Investor Day: 80% Gross Margin Target, Mid-to-High-Teens Revenue Growth; Stock Surges 16%+; JPMorgan Upgrades to OW
summary: SanDisk Investor Day (Aug 13) revealed long-term financial model: mid-to-high-teens revenue growth (2028-2030), gross margin target of 80% (vs. current ~56%). FY2026 revenue $20.25B (+175% YoY), net income $11.43B. New BiCS10 9th-gen flash with Kioxia for AI storage. Stock surged 16%+ to $1,528.11. JPMorgan (Harlan Sur) upgraded to Overweight, $2,250 target (Dec 2027).
why: 投资者日长期目标大超预期，16%单日暴涨创近期纪录；80%毛利率目标若实现是存储行业长期格局重塑信号；Sell Put行权价风险大幅降低，可考虑上调行权价捕获更高权利金或滚仓；同时利好美光（内存超周期叙事强化）。

title: Micron Extends AI-Fueled Monthly Rally; 2026 HBM Sold Out, Tightness Extends to 2027+; Analysts Cluster Near $1,500+ Targets
summary: MU advanced ~1.2% to $961.51 on Aug 14 (month-long +12% rally). Management: 2026 HBM supply entirely sold out under fixed-price contracts; conditions 'very tight' through 2027+. Analyst consensus targets ~$1,537–1,625 (UBS $1,625, BofA $1,550, New Street Research $1,250). KeyBanc sees DRAM prices +15-20% in Q3.
why: 美光HBM全年售罄且供给紧张延伸至2027+，内存超级周期叙事持续强化；分析师目标价普遍在$1,250-$1,625，当前约$960提供较大上行空间；期权Sell Put可考虑在利好持续的情况下适时建仓。

title: Gold Holds Above $4,400 on Aug 14 as Softening CPI/PPI Data Dim Fed Tightening Expectations
summary: Gold December futures near $4,408/oz on Aug 14, with spot ~$4,371–4,408, holding above $4,400 as back-to-back CPI/PPI prints reduce near-term Fed rate-hike premium. Core producer prices rose less than expected. Market closed Aug 15–16. Geopolitical safe-haven demand also supportive.
why: 金价稳守$4,400直接利好老铺黄金（6181.HK）；古法金首饰高端溢价与金价正相关；通胀降温+Fed按兵不动叙事若维持，黄金中长期走势偏强，支撑老铺黄金估值逻辑。

title: 小米集团HKEX公告：8月12日回购190万股B类股份，耗资HK$4,990万
summary: 香港交易所披露，小米集团（1810.HK）于2026年8月12日回购190万股B类股份，总耗资约4,990万港元。本次回购为公司HK$200亿自动回购计划的一部分，执行持续稳定。
why: 延续报道：小米持续执行HK$200亿回购计划，管理层通过回购彰显对YU7销量与长期价值的信心；回购对股价构成底部支撑，有助于降低Sell Put期权的下行风险。

title: Walmart to Host Q2 FY27 Earnings Call August 20; Analysts See EPS $0.74 (+8.8% YoY), Revenue $186.8B; Beat-and-Raise Expected
summary: Walmart (WMT) scheduled Q2 FY27 earnings conference call for August 20, 2026 (5 days away). Wall Street consensus: EPS $0.74 vs. $0.68 prior year; revenue $186.8B. 29 of 39 analysts rate Strong Buy; implied options swing ~4.6% around print. Global e-commerce +26% and ad revenue +37% drove Q1 FY27.
why: 沃尔玛财报5天后发布，财报前期权隐含波动率可能抬升，是Sell Put策略的潜在操作窗口；若业绩再次超预期+上调指引，WMT短期可能反应向上，有助于期权获利平仓。
